timeline_template.description_en: Set stakes and strings BEFORE sowing — untrellised snow peas trail on the ground and pod quality collapses.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka fito na kamba KABLA ya kupanda — bila kufungwa, mbaazi hutambaa na ubora wa maganda hupotea.

timeline_template.description_en: Direct-sow 25-40 kg per acre, 2-3 cm deep at 60cm × 10cm. Basal 50 kg DAP — light on nitrogen.
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda kilo 25-40 kwa eka, kina cha cm 2-3 kwa 60cm × 10cm. Weka kilo 50 za DAP — nitrojeni kidogo.

timeline_template.description_en: First weeding; guide tendrils onto the strings.
timeline_template.description_sw: Palia kwanza; ongoza michirizi kwenye kamba.

timeline_template.description_en: Top-dress 50 kg CAN per acre ONCE — no more. Start the mildew watch.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka kilo 50 za CAN MARA MOJA — usizidishe. Anza kuchunguza ukungu.

timeline_template.description_en: Pick pods FLAT, 7-9 cm, before the peas swell. Pick every 2-3 days — a missed round turns today's grade into tomorrow's cull.
timeline_template.description_sw: Vuna maganda GOROFU, sentimita 7-9, kabla ya mbaazi kuvimba. Vuna kila siku 2-3.
timeline_template.tip_en: The picking rhythm IS the export game — swollen pods are rejected at the packhouse.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Mwendo wa kuvuna NDIO mchezo wa kuuza nje — maganda yaliyovimba hukataliwa.

inputs_per_acre.product_name: Snow pea seed (Oregon Sugar Pod class)

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Export: flat, unblemished, 7-9 cm pods. Local: everything else. Grade at the vine.
post_harvest.packaging_standard: Single-layer cartons; cold chain 4-6°C within hours of picking.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: The packhouse doesn't negotiate — it grades. Keep the picking calendar like a contract.
post_harvest.storage_tips_sw: Packhouse haijadili — inapanga daraja. Shika kalenda ya kuvuna kama mkataba.

diseases.symptoms_en: White dusting on leaves, vine burn, small pods, cool-dry spells.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Unga mweupe majani, miti kuungua, maganda madogo, baridi-kavu.
diseases.treatment_en: Sulphur-class products at first dusting — prevention beats pod loss. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za salfa mara inapoanza — kinga ni bora kuliko hasara ya maganda. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Airflow, resistant varieties, avoid water stress.
diseases.prevention_sw: Hewa, aina sugu, epuka mkazo wa maji.
diseases.scanner_notes: Vine-level photo; early dusting on lower leaves first.

diseases.symptoms_en: Yellow patches above, grey-purple fuzz below, cool damp spells.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya manjano juu, ukungu wa kijivu chini, baridi na unyevu.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered downy-active sprays at first patches. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa iliyoidhinishwa ya ukungu mara inapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.

diseases.symptoms_en: Curled new growth, colonies on undersides, mottled virus symptoms.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Majani machanga yaliyokunjika, makundi chini, dalili za virusi.
diseases.treatment_en: Early aphid control only. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dhibiti vidukari mapema tu. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_sw: Chunguza kila wiki, maadui wa asili kwanza.

diseases.symptoms_en: Yellowing patches, dying plants, rotting roots in wet soil.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Mapande ya manjano, mimea inayokufa, mizizi inayooza.
diseases.treatment_en: None — drainage is the cure. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — mifereji ndio dawa. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Raised beds, rotation away from legumes.
diseases.prevention_sw: Vitanda vilivyoinuliwa, zungusha mbali na mikunde.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photograph an uprooted plant with washed roots.

diseases.symptoms_en: Silvery tunnels through leaves, cosmetic damage.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Michirizi ya fedha ndani ya majani, hudhuru sura.
diseases.treatment_en: Threshold management; remove mined leaves. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dhibiti kwa kiwango; ondoa majani yaliyoathirika. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.scanner_notes: Backlit photo shows the tunnel track.

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Export-grade pods fetch several times the local price — the difference is the picking discipline and the grading. Cool highlands ARE the production zone.
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Maganda ya kuuza nje yana bei mara kadhaa ya ndani — tofauti ni nidhamu ya kuvuna na kupanga daraja. Nyanda za juu baridi NDIO eneo la uzalishaji.
market_notes.price_notes_en: Export 200–400 KES per kg, local 80–150 (November 2026). Input bill 30,000–50,000 KES per acre — seed is heavy and the trellis is real.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: Nje KES 200–400 kwa kilo, ndani 80–150 (Novemba 2026). Gharama 30,000–50,000 KES kwa eka.
